Name: Berserker_trunk_000
Description: Unlocks the Fury resource. Gain 1 Fury per critical strike. Fury begins decaying at 10 Fury/s after 3 seconds out of combat. Base of 100 Fury.

Name: Berserker_trunk_001
Description: +1 Fury gained per point on every critical melee strike.

Name: Berserker_trunk_002
Description: +0.3% life leech per point on all melee attacks.

Name: Berserker_trunk_003
Description: +3% critical strike chance per point on melee attacks.

Name: Berserker_trunk_004
Description: +10 maximum Fury per point. At 5 points: Every 20 points of maximum Fury you have also grants 1% damage reduction.

Name: Berserker_trunk_005
Description: +5% critical strike multiplier per point on melee attacks.

Name: Berserker_trunk_006
Description: Life leech can overheal you up to 30% above your maximum HP. Bonus HP from overleech decays at 1% per second when you are not leeching. While you have any overleech HP, incoming damage removes overleech before your actual HP.

Name: Berserker_trunk_007
Description: Reduce your passive Fury loss by 0.2 per point.

Name: Berserker_trunk_008
Description: When your Fury reaches 0 for any reason, your next melee attack within 3 seconds deals bonus damage equal to 5% per point of your maximum Fury.

Name: Berserker_trunk_009
Description: When you reach maximum Fury your next melee attack consumes all Fury. For each point of Fury consumed that attack deals +10% bonus damage per point invested.

Name: Berserker_trunk_010
Description: +2% melee damage per point for 4 seconds after attacking at maximum Fury.

Name: Berserker_trunk_011
Description: You gain 1% damage reduction for every 4% of your maximum Fury you currently hold, up to 25% at maximum Fury.

Name: Berserker_trunk_012
Description: While below 30% HP your Fury generation is tripled and Berserking triggers on every melee hit rather than only when Fury is full.

Name: Berserker_twoh_001
Description: Two-handed weapons only. When you reach maximum Fury, enter a state of Wrath. While in Wrath your melee attacks deal +15% damage. Fury drains at 5 per second. Wrath ends when Fury reaches 0.

Name: Berserker_twoh_002
Description: Two-handed weapons only. Each consecutive melee hit on the same target increases your damage by 3% per point up to 5 consecutive hits. While in Wrath, this bonus is gained twice as fast. Switching targets resets the bonus.

Name: Berserker_twoh_003
Description: Two-handed weapons only. +6% critical strike multiplier per point. While in Wrath, critical strikes drain an additional 3 Fury per hit in exchange for applying a 2-second armor reduction of 10% per point on the target. At 5 points: This armor reduction stacks up to 6 times instead of 4.

Name: Berserker_twoh_004
Description: Two-handed weapons only. Your melee attacks hit all enemies in a 180 degree arc in front of you. Arc width increases by 10 degrees per point. Each enemy hit beyond the first costs 5 Fury and generates 3 Fury per point if Fury was available to pay the cost.

Name: Berserker_twoh_005
Description: Two-handed weapons only. +8% chance per point to stagger an enemy on melee hit, interrupting any action they were performing.

Name: Berserker_twoh_006
Description: Two-handed weapons only. +10% damage per point against staggered enemies.

Name: Berserker_twoh_007
Description: Two-handed weapons only. +5% critical strike chance per point on melee attacks against enemies below 25% HP.

Name: Berserker_twoh_008
Description: Two-handed weapons only. When you attack at maximum Fury, the force of the attack releases a shockwave that deals 30% of your attack damage per point to all enemies within 5 meters.

Name: Berserker_twoh_009
Description: Two-handed weapons only. Critical melee strikes reduce enemy armor by 5% per point for 5 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

Name: Berserker_twoh_010
Description: Two-handed weapons only. +3% movement speed per point. At 5 points: You cannot be staggered, stunned, or knocked back while above 50% Fury.

Name: Berserker_twoh_011
Description: Two-handed weapons only. While in Wrath, drain 4 additional Fury per second to increase all melee damage by +10% per point. This bonus is lost immediately if Wrath ends.

Name: Berserker_twoh_012
Description: Two-handed weapons only. When you attack at maximum Fury, the shockwave from the attack travels along the ground dealing 30% per point of the hit's damage to all enemies in a line.

Name: Berserker_twoh_013
Description: Two-handed weapons only. Melee attacks made at maximum Fury deal an additional +1% damage per point for every 1% of HP the target is missing.

Name: Berserker_twoh_014
Description: Two-handed weapons only. +5% AOE radius per point on all attacks. At 5 points: Enemies killed by AOE damage explode, dealing 20% of their max HP as damage to nearby enemies.

Name: Berserker_twoh_015
Description: Two-handed weapons only. +6% critical strike multiplier per point on melee attacks. At 10 points: when you attack at maximum Fury, all enemies below 25% HP are instantly killed.

Name: Berserker_twoh_016
Description: Two-handed weapons only. While in Wrath, each enemy within melee range drains 3 additional Fury per second. For each enemy draining Fury this way, your melee damage is increased by +8% per point.

Name: Berserker_twoh_ks_001
Description: Two-handed weapons only. While in Wrath, using a movement skill triggers your Earthquake skill at your landing location at no cooldown cost. The damage and AOE radius of this Earthquake are scaled by your current Fury at the moment of landing — 100% potency at maximum Fury, scaling down to 25% potency at minimum Fury. All modifiers to your Earthquake skill apply normally.

Name: Berserker_twoh_ks_002
Description: Two-handed weapons only. Effects that trigger at maximum Fury no longer drain your Fury when they fire.

Name: Berserker_twoh_ks_003
Description: Two-handed weapons only. Killing an enemy with an attack made at maximum Fury instantly reduces all cooldowns by 50%

Name: Berserker_dw_001
Description: Dual wield only. When you reach maximum Fury, enter a state of Frenzy. While in Frenzy your attack speed is increased by 20% and all melee hits generate 2 additional Fury. Fury drains at 8 per second. Frenzy ends when Fury reaches 0.

Name: Berserker_dw_002
Description: Dual wield only. Every 5th consecutive melee attack triggers an additional offhand strike dealing 50% weapon damage per point.

Name: Berserker_dw_003
Description: Dual wield only. Alternating main hand and offhand attacks increases damage by 2% per point up to 6 stacks. While in Frenzy, each alternating strike costs 3 Fury but the damage bonus per stack is doubled.

Name: Berserker_dw_004
Description: Dual wield only. Each melee hit reduces the target's damage reduction by 1% per point for 3 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Stacks refresh on each hit. At 5 points: The stack cap is increased to 8.

Name: Berserker_dw_005
Description: Dual wield only. While in Frenzy, every melee hit that does not crit still generates +1 Fury per point. Reduces the effective drain rate of Frenzy by rewarding consistent aggression.

Name: Berserker_dw_006
Description: Dual wield only. Critical melee strikes apply a wound to the target for 2 seconds per point. While wounded, the target takes +3% increased damage per point from all sources. Applying a new wound refreshes the duration.

Name: Berserker_dw_007
Description: Dual wield only. While in Frenzy, each unique enemy you have hit in the last 3 seconds drains 2 additional Fury per second and grants +6% damage per point against that enemy. Tracking ends if Frenzy ends.

Name: Berserker_dw_008
Description: Dual wield only. +0.3% life leech per point for each melee attack you have landed in the last 2 seconds, up to 10 attacks. While in Frenzy this cap is doubled.

Name: Berserker_dw_009
Description: Dual wield only. Each time you attack at maximum Fury your melee attack speed increases by 5% per point for 3 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

Name: Berserker_dw_010
Description: Dual wield only. +1% damage per point for each melee attack you have landed in the last 2 seconds, up to 10 attacks. Resets if you go 2 seconds without landing a hit. At 5 points: The tracking window is extended to 3 seconds.

Name: Berserker_dw_011
Description: Dual wield only. Each melee hit increases your movement speed by 2% per point for 4 seconds. Multiple hits refresh the duration and stack the bonus up to 5 times.

Name: Berserker_dw_012
Description: Dual wield only. While in Frenzy, for every 10 Fury drained by the Frenzy state, automatically trigger a bonus strike at 20% weapon damage per point. These strikes can proc leech and critical strikes independently.

Name: Berserker_dw_013
Description: Dual wield only. Melee attacks against enemies below 20% HP deal bonus damage equal to +2% per point of the target's missing HP percentage. While in Frenzy this threshold is increased to 35%.

Name: Berserker_dw_014
Description: Dual wield only. While in Frenzy, your critical strike chance is increased by 2% per point. This bonus is doubled while above 75% Fury.

Name: Berserker_dw_015
Description: Dual wield only. Killing an enemy refunds 20% of your maximum Fury per point up to a maximum of 60%.

Name: Berserker_dw_016
Description: Dual wield only. Killing an enemy increases your attack speed by 4% per point for 4 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. While in Frenzy kills also restore 5 Fury.

Name: Berserker_dw_017
Description: Dual wield only. Killing an enemy while in Frenzy extends the current Frenzy duration by 1 second per point, up to a maximum extension of 6 seconds. This can trigger multiple times per Frenzy.

Name: Berserker_dw_018
Description: Dual wield only. Each automatic strike triggered by Frenetic generates 2 Fury per point.

Name: Berserker_dw_ks_001
Description: Dual wield only. When you attack at maximum Fury the strike automatically becomes a spinning attack hitting all enemies within melee range. Each enemy hit generates 3 Fury. Enemies hit while you are at maximum Fury are knocked back and take 50% bonus damage.

Name: Berserker_dw_ks_002
Description: Dual wield only. Killing an enemy while in Frenzy immediately resets the Frenetic auto-strike timer. Additionally, entering Frenzy instantly triggers three bonus strikes at full damage.

Name: Berserker_dw_ks_003
Description: Dual wield only. Each melee strike creates a phantasmal echo that replays the attack 0.75 seconds later at 60% damage. Phantom strikes can trigger leech and critical strikes independently but do not generate Fury.

Name: Berserker_crit_001
Description: +4% critical strike multiplier per point on melee attacks. Critical strikes also generate +2 Fury per point. At 5 points: Critical strikes made while above 75% Fury generate double Fury from this effect.

Name: Berserker_crit_002
Description: +2% critical strike chance per point on melee attacks. While above 50% Fury, your critical strike chance is additionally increased by 1% per point.

Name: Berserker_crit_003
Description: +8% critical strike multiplier per point on melee attacks. At 4 points: Your critical melee strikes ignore 20% of enemy resistances. Each point of Fury above your normal maximum (from any source) increases your critical strike multiplier by an additional 0.5% per point invested here.

Name: Berserker_crit_004
Description: Critical strikes apply a Deathmark for 5 seconds. Applying a Deathmark costs 10 Fury, reduced by 1 per point. Marked enemies take +3% increased damage per point from all sources. If you have no Fury the mark still applies but deals no bonus damage.

Name: Berserker_crit_005
Description: +5% critical strike multiplier per point for each consecutive critical strike, up to 5 stacks. Missing a critical strike or your Fury reaching 0 resets the streak.

Name: Berserker_crit_ks_001
Description: Your critical strikes deal bonus damage equal to 2% of the target's missing HP. This bonus is tripled on attacks made at maximum Fury.

Name: Berserker_crit_ks_002
Description: Critical strike chance past 100% is converted to critical strike multiplier at a 2:1 ratio.

Name: Berserker_leech_001
Description: +0.5% life leech per point on melee attacks. At 5 points: Life leech is applied instantly rather than over time. Every 10 Fury you spend or drain generates a heal equal to 0.5% per point of your maximum HP.

Name: Berserker_leech_002
Description: Your maximum HP bonus from all sources also increases your maximum Fury by 1 point for every 2% maximum HP bonus you have.

Name: Berserker_leech_003
Description: +1% life leech per point on critical melee strikes only. Critical strike leech is not subject to the normal leech cap. Excess leech beyond your HP cap is stored and added as bonus Fury generation on your next hit, up to 10 Fury per point.

Name: Berserker_leech_004
Description: When you would be reduced to 0 HP, if you have at least 50 Fury, you are instead reduced to 1 HP. All of your Fury is instantly spent, restoring HP equal to 5% of your maximum HP per 10 Fury spent.

Name: Berserker_leech_005
Description: +1% life leech per point on melee attacks. Each time you leech HP your Fury generation on the next hit is increased by 1 per point, stacking up to 5 times. Stacks reset if you go 2 seconds without leeching. At 4 points: The stack cap is increased to 10.

Name: Berserker_leech_006
Description: +0.3% life leech per point for every 10 Fury you currently have. When your Fury reaches 0 for any reason you instantly leech 1% per point of your maximum HP.

Name: Berserker_leech_ks_001
Description: Life leech now also restores Fury at a rate of 1 Fury per 2% of maximum HP leeched. Fury cannot be restored above maximum by this effect.

Name: Berserker_capstone_25
Description: Unlocks at 25 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.
Option1Description: Two-handed weapons only. While above 50% Fury, your melee attacks reduce the armor of all enemies within 5 meters by 15% for 3 seconds. This effect refreshes on each hit.
Option2Description: Dual wield only. Entering Frenzy immediately resets the cooldown of your movement skill.
Option3Description: While above 50% Fury, all incoming damage is reduced by your current life leech percentage.

Name: Berserker_capstone_50
Description: Unlocks at 50 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.
Option1Description: Two-handed weapons only. While above 75% Fury you cannot be slowed, rooted, or knocked back.
Option2Description: Dual wield only. While in Frenzy, your movement speed is increased by 5% for each enemy within melee range.
Option3Description: Your critical strike multiplier is increased by 1% for every 1% of HP you are currently missing.

Name: Berserker_capstone_100
Description: Unlocks at 100 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.
Option1Description: Two-handed weapons only. Your maximum HP is increased by 1% for every 2 points of maximum Fury you have.
Option2Description: Dual wield only. While in Frenzy, critical strikes release a nova of force that deals 30% of the hit's damage to all enemies within melee range.
Option3Description: Your critical strike multiplier bonus is added to your life leech percentage. Your life leech percentage is added to your critical strike multiplier bonus.

Name: Berserker_capstone_200
Description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.
Option1Description: Two-handed weapons only. Your maximum Fury is doubled. While in Wrath, your attacks release shockwaves that deal 50% of the hit's damage to all enemies within 6 meters. Wrath no longer drains Fury passively.
Option2Description: Dual wield only. While in Frenzy, your attacks chain to one additional nearby enemy for 60% damage. Each kill during Frenzy permanently adds one additional chain target for the remainder of the Frenzy duration.
Option3Description: Your life leech cap is removed entirely. Any HP restored by life leech beyond your maximum is added as overleech that decays at 1% per second. Life leech effectiveness is increased by 50%.

Name: Bulwark_basic_trunk_000
Description: Unlocks the Resolve resource. Resolve is generated by taking hits, blocking, and killing enemies. It decays slowly out of combat. Base Resolve is 100.

Name: Bulwark_basic_trunk_001
Description: +3% Armor per point.

Name: Bulwark_basic_trunk_002
Description: +2% Maximum HP per point. At 5 points: Gain HP equal to 10% of your Armor value.

Name: Bulwark_basic_trunk_004
Description: +4% HP Regen per point.

Name: Bulwark_basic_trunk_008
Description: +1.5% damage reduction per point (multiplicative).

Name: Bulwark_basic_trunk_003
Description: +3% damage per point.

Name: Bulwark_basic_trunk_005
Description: +10% Maximum Resolve per point. At 8 points: Resolve no longer decays while you are in combat.

Name: Bulwark_basic_trunk_007
Description: +1 Resolve generated from taking hits per point. At 5 points: Taking a hit that would reduce you below 30% HP generates an additional 10 Resolve.

Name: Bulwark_basic_trunk_006
Description: +2% Armor and +1% damage for every 25 Resolve currently held per point. At 6 points: These bonuses are doubled while at maximum Resolve.

Name: Bulwark_keystone_trunk_001
Description: You cannot be stunned while above 50 Resolve.

Name: Bulwark_keystone_trunk_002
Description: Killing an enemy generates 1 Resolve, up to 5 per second.

Name: Bulwark_keystone_trunk_003
Description: When you drop below 20% HP, instantly gain 50 Resolve. Can only trigger once every 60 seconds.

Name: Bulwark_basic_trunk_009
Description: While above 50 Resolve, gain +3% damage reduction per point. This bonus drains 5 Resolve per second while active. At 6 points: Reduces the drain rate to 2 Resolve per second.

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_stem_001
Description: +2% Block Chance per point. At 5 points: Blocking an attack generates 3 Resolve.

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_stem_002
Description: +4% damage reduction on a successful block per point (multiplicative).

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_resolve_001
Description: While above 75 Resolve, blocked attacks automatically negate all damage from that hit, draining 20 Resolve per block. Per point: reduces the Resolve drain by 2.

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_stem_003
Description: +2% Armor per point while a shield is equipped.

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_t2_001
Description: +3% Maximum HP per point while a shield is equipped.

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_t1_001
Description: +4% damage per point for 3 seconds after taking a hit. At 6 points: If you take two hits within 1 second, this bonus is doubled.

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_t2_002
Description: +2% damage reduction per successive block per point, stacking up to 5 times. Resets if you take an unblocked hit.

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_t1_002
Description: +3% damage per point for 3 seconds after a successful block.

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_t2_003
Description: +2% damage per point for every 10% Block Chance you have. At 6 points: Whenever you take a hit while your block streak is active, your next attack deals bonus flat damage equal to 5% of your Armor value.

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_stem_004
Description: +3% damage per point for every 10% Block Chance you have.

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_t1_003
Description: +2% of blocked damage is added to your next attack per point. At 5 points: This bonus is tripled if you block 5 times without attacking.

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_stem_005
Description: +1% Block Chance per 10 Resolve currently held per point.

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_t3_001
Description: +3% Resolve generation from blocking per point. At 5 points: While at maximum Resolve, blocking deals 200 flat damage back to the attacker.

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_t3_002
Description: +2% damage reduction per point for each enemy within 3 meters (multiplicative). At 6 points: Also grants +1% Block Chance per nearby enemy.

Name: Bulwark_basic_ic_final_001
Description: +2% of your total Block Chance is added as flat damage reduction per point (multiplicative).

Name: Bulwark_keystone_ic_t1
Description: After a successful block, if you have at least 25 Resolve, automatically unleash a counter-attack dealing damage equal to 75% of the damage just blocked, draining 25 Resolve. While at maximum Resolve this counter-attack also stuns the target for 1 second.

Name: Bulwark_keystone_ic_t2
Description: Every block within 3 seconds of the last increases Block Chance by 5% and generates 3 Resolve, stacking up to 4 times. Resets if you stop blocking for 3 seconds.

Name: Bulwark_keystone_ic_t3
Description: While 3 or more enemies are within 3 meters, you gain 10 Resolve per second and your Block Chance cannot be reduced below 30%.

Name: Bulwark_keystone_ic_final
Description: When you block an attack that would have killed you, instead survive at 1 HP, gain 100 Resolve, and become immune to damage for 2 seconds. Can only trigger once every 120 seconds.

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_stem_001
Description: +4% Maximum HP per point. Each 1,000 Maximum HP above 5,000 increases your Resolve cap by 5.

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_stem_002
Description: +50 flat HP Regen per second per point.

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_resolve_001
Description: Lose 5 Resolve for every 100 flat HP regenerated. While above 50% Resolve, gain 50% Maximum HP. At 6 points: The Resolve cost is reduced to 1 per 150 HP regenerated.

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_t1_001
Description: +2% damage reduction per point while you have not moved in the last 2 seconds. At 5 points: While stationary, your Resolve generation from taking hits is doubled.

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_stem_003
Description: +100 flat damage per point. Requires 5,000 Maximum HP to activate.

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_t1_002
Description: +15% crowd control duration reduction per point. Each crowd control effect applied to you generates 10 Resolve.

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_stem_004
Description: +200 flat HP per point for every 10,000 Maximum HP you have. Requires 10,000 Maximum HP to activate.

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_t1_003
Description: +3% damage reduction per point while crowd controlled (multiplicative). At 4 points: Taking a crowd control effect retaliates with 500 flat damage.

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_t2_001
Description: +2% damage reduction per point for every 5,000 Maximum HP above 10,000 (multiplicative).

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_stem_005
Description: +1% damage per point for every 1,000 Maximum HP above 10,000.

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_t2_002
Description: +50 flat damage per point for every 5,000 Maximum HP you have. Requires 8,000 Maximum HP to activate.

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_t3_001
Description: +2% damage per point for every 5 seconds in continuous combat, stacking up to 10 times.

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_t2_003
Description: +4% chance per point for melee attacks to deal bonus flat damage equal to 1% of your Maximum HP. At 5 points: This bonus damage hits all enemies within 2 meters.

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_t3_002
Description: +1% damage reduction per point for every 10 seconds in continuous combat (multiplicative), stacking up to 5 times. At 5 points: Combat duration stacks are lost 50% slower when leaving combat.

Name: Bulwark_basic_jg_final_001
Description: +500 flat Maximum HP per point. At 6 points: For every 10,000 Maximum HP you have, gain 1% of your Maximum HP as flat damage reduction (multiplicative).

Name: Bulwark_keystone_jg_t1
Description: While above 15,000 Maximum HP, you are immune to all crowd control effects. Enemies that attempt to crowd control you instead take 500 flat damage.

Name: Bulwark_keystone_jg_t2
Description: Once every 10 seconds, your next attack deals bonus damage equal to 5% of your Maximum HP as flat damage. Requires 20,000 Maximum HP to activate.

Name: Bulwark_keystone_jg_t3
Description: After 10 seconds in continuous combat, you emit an aura that deals flat damage per second to all nearby enemies equal to 1% of your Maximum HP. This damage increases by 0.5% of your Maximum HP for every additional 10 seconds in combat, up to a maximum of 3% of your Maximum HP per second.

Name: Bulwark_keystone_jg_final
Description: When you absorb a single hit exceeding 5,000 flat damage, you become unkillable for 2 seconds and your next attack deals damage equal to the full amount of that hit. Requires 25,000 Maximum HP to activate. Can only trigger once every 30 seconds.

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_stem_001
Description: +2% damage reflected to attackers per point (multiplicative).

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_stem_002
Description: +3% damage reduction per point (multiplicative). At 6 points: Each hit you survive increases your retaliation damage by 1% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_t2_001
Description: +3% bonus retaliation damage per point for hits that deal more than 10% of your max HP in a single strike.

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_stem_003
Description: +3% Resolve generated from taking hits per point. At 5 points: When you reach maximum Resolve from taking hits, your next retaliation deals 50% bonus damage.

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_resolve_001
Description: Passively drains 10 Resolve per second to increase your retaliation damage by +3% per point. When this drain reduces you to 0 Resolve, automatically trigger a retaliation pulse hitting all nearby enemies for 100% of your retaliation damage. At 5 points: This pulse also applies a bleed stack to all enemies hit.

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_t2_002
Description: +5% retaliation damage per point for 5 seconds after taking a hit that reduces you below 50% HP.

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_stem_004
Description: +2% retaliation damage per point for each unique enemy that has hit you in the last 10 seconds. While at maximum Resolve, your retaliation damage hits all nearby enemies rather than just your attacker.

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_t2_003
Description: +2% damage per point for every 10% of missing HP. At 5 points: This bonus also applies to retaliation damage.

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_t1_001
Description: +10% bleed duration per point applied by your retaliation damage.

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_t3_001
Description: +5% aura retaliation damage per point. Enemies within 3 meters take retaliation damage equal to a percentage of damage dealt to you.

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_t1_002
Description: +5% bleed damage per point for each bleed stack on the target.

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_t3_002
Description: +1 meter to retaliation aura radius per point. At 4 points: Enemies killed within the aura explode, dealing retaliation damage to nearby enemies.

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_stem_005
Description: +1% retaliation damage per point for every 10 Resolve currently held.

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_t1_003
Description: +3% retaliation damage per point for each bleed stack on any nearby enemy. At 5 points: Enemies with 5 or more bleed stacks take 20% increased damage from all sources.

Name: Bulwark_basic_tw_final_001
Description: +3% retaliation damage per point for every 10% HP missing. At 6 points: While below 25% HP, retaliation damage is doubled and cannot be reduced by enemy resistances.

Name: Bulwark_keystone_tw_t2
Description: Convert all of your Armor into flat HP. For every 1% Armor lost this way, gain 3% Maximum HP. You can no longer equip shields. Gain 50% increased Resolve from all sources.

Name: Bulwark_keystone_tw_t1
Description: Your retaliation damage no longer deals instant damage. Instead it is converted into a bleed whose total damage equals the amount that would have been reflected.

Name: Bulwark_keystone_tw_t3
Description: Your retaliation aura now pulses every second, dealing damage equal to 5% of all damage you have taken in the last 5 seconds to all nearby enemies.

Name: Bulwark_keystone_tw_final
Description: 50% of all damage you take is reflected back to the attacker. This reflection ignores resistances and cannot be blocked or evaded. The reflection percentage increases by 1% for every 5 Resolve currently held, up to a maximum of 100% at full Resolve.

Name: Bulwark_capstone_25
Description: Unlocks at 25 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.
Option2Description: Regenerate 1% of your current HP per second.
Option3Description: Your retaliation damage ignores 25% of enemy resistances.

Name: Bulwark_capstone_50
Description: Unlocks at 50 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.
Option1Description: Your Block Chance is doubled while you have not attacked in the last 3 seconds.
Option3Description: Enemies that hit you are inflicted with a stack of Exposed. Each stack of Exposed increases the retaliation damage they take from you by 5%, stacking up to 10 times.

Name: Bulwark_capstone_100
Description: Unlocks at 100 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.
Option1Description: Your Maximum HP is increased by 1% for every 1% Block Chance you have.
Option2Description: Your retaliation damage is increased by 1% for every 75 HP you are missing.
Option3Description: Blocked damage is stored and added to your next retaliation hit.

Name: Bulwark_capstone_200
Description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.
Option1Description: You may equip a shield in your primary weapon slot. You may now block AOE damage.
Option2Description: All healing, regeneration, and HP bonuses are doubled. While above 50% HP, you are immune to instant-kill effects. While above 75% HP, your attacks deal bonus damage equal to 2% of your current HP.
Option3Description: Your retaliation damage percentage is added to your total Armor, and your Armor contributes to your retaliation damage proportional to the damage reduction it provides. When you take a hit that would deal more than 10% of your Maximum HP in a single strike, you erupt — instantly retaliating against all nearby enemies for 200% of your retaliation damage.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_000
Description: Unlocks the Preparation resource. Preparation is generated by placing traps and gadgets, and whenever your traps or gadgets deal damage or trigger. It does not decay.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_001
Description: +10% trap trigger radius per point. At 5 points: Traps arm instantly upon placement instead of after a 1 second delay.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_002
Description: When Preparation is generated while already at maximum, gain a stack of Overkill granting +5% damage. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 2 seconds.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_003
Description: +5 maximum Preparation per point. At 6 points: Your Preparation cannot be reduced by enemy effects.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_004
Description: +1% evasion chance per point. At 5 points: After successfully evading, gain 3 Preparation.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_005
Description: +5% of your current evasion chance per point while moving.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_006
Description: +1 to maximum active traps and gadgets per point.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_007
Description: +3% trap and explosive area of effect per point. At 5 points: Trap explosions leave a burning patch for 2 seconds dealing 10% of their damage per second.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_008
Description: +3% gadget damage per point. At 6 points: Gadgets remain active 20% longer per point invested beyond 6.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_009
Description: +2% damage per point for 3 seconds after successfully evading.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_010
Description: +2% to all damage per point while above 50% of your maximum Preparation.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_stem_001
Description: +6% trap arming speed per point. At 4 points: Traps can be placed while moving without interrupting your movement.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_stem_002
Description: +10% trap trigger radius per point. At 4 points: Traps trigger 20% faster after detecting an enemy.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_stem_003
Description: Each active trap on the battlefield reduces the trigger delay of all your other traps by 0.1 seconds per point, to a minimum of 0.1 seconds.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_stem_004
Description: +5% trap damage per point against enemies that have not yet triggered one of your traps.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_stem_005
Description: +1 Preparation per point when a trap is triggered.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_qty_001
Description: +10% trap placement speed per point. At 6 points: Your maximum active trap limit is increased by 1.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_qty_002
Description: When a trap is triggered, the nearest inactive trap within 8 meters is also triggered. At 4 points: This chain can occur once per second.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_qty_003
Description: Your evasion chance cap is increased by 5% for each active trap on the battlefield. Bonus evasion from this effect is not subject to the normal 60% cap.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_qty_004
Description: When you deploy a trap, there is a 10% chance per point to spend 20 Preparation to deploy an additional trap at a random nearby location.

Name: Saboteur_keystone_trap_qty
Description: While at maximum active traps, you deal 50% more trap damage and trap trigger radius is doubled.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_ql_001
Description: +10% trap damage per point against the first enemy to trigger each trap.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_ql_002
Description: Traps are not consumed when triggered. Instead each subsequent trigger costs 15 Preparation, reduced by 1 Preparation per point. At 5 points: Each subsequent trigger deals 20% more damage than the last.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_ql_003
Description: Your traps have a 1 second additional arming delay but deal +15% damage per point and cannot be accidentally triggered by you or your gadgets during the arming period.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_ql_004
Description: Enemies that trigger a trap are marked for 5 seconds. Marked enemies take +5% increased damage per point from all sources.

Name: Saboteur_keystone_trap_ql
Description: You may only have one active trap at a time. That trap gains +10% damage and +25% area of effect for each point of your maximum trap limit. Your maximum trap limit still benefits from all other sources.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_deep_001
Description: +15% area of effect for traps per point.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_deep_002
Description: +3% DoT damage per point applied by traps. At 6 points: Enemies standing in an area where a trap was triggered continue to take DoT damage for 3 seconds.

Name: Saboteur_keystone_trap_deep_001
Description: When your last active trap is triggered, it deals damage equal to the combined total damage of all traps triggered in the last 10 seconds. This can only occur once every 30 seconds.

Name: Saboteur_keystone_trap_deep_002
Description: Your traps no longer have a maximum active limit. Instead each active trap beyond your normal maximum drains 5 Preparation per second. When you reach 0 Preparation all excess traps are immediately triggered simultaneously.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_stem_001
Description: +12% gadget deployment speed per point. At 4 points: Deploying a gadget does not interrupt any action you are currently performing.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_stem_002
Description: +8% gadget HP per point. At 5 points: When a gadget is destroyed, gain 10 Preparation.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_stem_003
Description: Each active gadget on the battlefield extends the active duration of all your other gadgets by 2 seconds per point.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_stem_004
Description: When a gadget is deployed, it automatically consumes 2 Preparation per point to grant +5% damage and +5% HP per Preparation consumed.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_stem_005
Description: +3% gadget damage per point for each active trap on the battlefield. At 4 points: Active gadgets increase trap trigger radius by 10%.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_dep_001
Description: +2% gadget attack speed per point for every 10 Preparation spent in the last 5 seconds.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_dep_002
Description: When a gadget is deployed, it passively drains 2 Preparation per point over 10 seconds, gaining +5% attack speed for each Preparation drained.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_dep_003
Description: When a gadget is destroyed, it explodes dealing damage equal to +15% of its maximum HP per point to all nearby enemies.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_dep_004
Description: When a gadget is reduced below 25% HP, it gains +8% attack speed and +8% damage per point for 5 seconds.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_dep_005
Description: Reduces the Preparation cost of all automatic gadget empowerment effects by 1 per point. At 6 points: Once every 15 seconds, your next gadget deployment costs no Preparation to empower.

Name: Saboteur_keystone_gadget_dep
Description: When you deploy a gadget, all other active gadgets are pulled to the most recent gadget.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_sus_001
Description: Gadgets passively drain 1 Preparation per second while active. Your gadgets gain +4% damage per point for each point of Preparation above 50% of your maximum that you currently have.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_sus_002
Description: +15% gadget HP regeneration per point per second while above 50% HP. At 4 points: Gadgets that survive for 20 seconds gain a permanent +10% damage stack.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_sus_003
Description: Your gadgets build a charge over time, gaining one stack every 5 seconds up to a maximum of 5 stacks. At maximum stacks the gadget discharges, dealing 40% of its attack damage to all nearby enemies and resetting to 0 stacks.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_sus_004
Description: +2% gadget damage per point for each second a gadget has been continuously active up to a maximum of 20 seconds.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_sus_005
Description: +5% chance per point that a gadget ignores damage from a hit entirely. At 6 points: When a gadget successfully ignores damage gain 5 Preparation.

Name: Saboteur_keystone_gadget_sus
Description: After remaining stationary for 3 seconds your gadgets gain +5% damage and +3% range per second stationary up to a maximum of 10 seconds. Moving more than 10 meters from any active gadget resets the bonus.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_deep_001
Description: +8% gadget attack range per point for each active gadget on the battlefield. At 5 points: Gadgets can attack enemies through terrain within their range.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_deep_002
Description: Once per second when you hit an enemy your nearest active gadget also attacks that enemy dealing +8% bonus damage per point. At 4 points: This effect triggers for all active gadgets simultaneously.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_deep_003
Description: When a gadget is destroyed gain +5 Preparation per point and reduce the deployment cooldown of your next gadget by 2 seconds per point.

Name: Saboteur_keystone_gadget_deep_001
Description: Your maximum active gadget limit is increased by 1. Your gadgets gain +1% bonus damage and +5% bonus HP per 10 Preparation.

Name: Saboteur_keystone_gadget_deep_002
Description: Each active gadget on the battlefield grants you +15% damage, +8% evasion chance, and +15 maximum Preparation. These bonuses update in real time as gadgets are deployed or destroyed.

Name: Saboteur_capstone_25
Description: Unlocks at 25 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

Name: Saboteur_capstone_50
Description: Unlocks at 50 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

Name: Saboteur_capstone_100
Description: Unlocks at 100 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

Name: Saboteur_capstone_200
Description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_011
Description: +1% movement speed per point. At 5 points: While above 50% maximum Preparation, gain an additional 2% movement speed per point.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_012
Description: +3% evasion chance per point for 3 seconds after placing a trap or gadget.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_013
Description: You cannot be targeted while moving. Taking damage breaks this effect for 2 seconds.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trunk_014
Description: +3% damage reduction per point. At 4 points: This damage reduction is doubled while above 50% maximum Preparation.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_mid_001
Description: Traps apply a 20% slow per point to triggered enemies for 2 seconds. At 4 points: Enemies slowed by your traps also take +15% increased damage from all trap sources.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_mid_002
Description: +3% movement speed per point for 3 seconds after one of your traps is triggered.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_mid_003
Description: Your traps do not reveal your position when triggered. Additionally, the first enemy to enter each trap's trigger radius is rooted for 0.5 seconds per point before the trap fires.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_mid_004
Description: +8% trap attack speed and trigger rate per point for each unique trap type currently active on the battlefield.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_mid_005
Description: +10% chance per point that triggering a trap also applies a bleed stack to the triggering enemy.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_mid_006
Description: +4% evasion chance per point while you have at least one active trap on the battlefield.

Name: Saboteur_basic_trap_mid_007
Description: +5% trap damage per point for every 10% of your evasion chance, up to a maximum of 60%.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_mid_001
Description: +2% movement speed per point for each active gadget on the battlefield.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_mid_002
Description: +4% evasion chance per point while any of your gadgets are under attack.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_mid_003
Description: When one of your traps is triggered, the nearest active gadget immediately fires at the triggering enemy. When one of your gadgets is destroyed, the nearest active trap triggers instantly.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_mid_004
Description: +5% movement speed and +5% evasion per point for 5 seconds when a gadget is destroyed.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_mid_005
Description: Your evasion chance is permanently set to 0%. All gadget damage is increased by 3% for every 1% of evasion chance you would have had from all sources.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_mid_006
Description: +2% evasion chance per point while within 15 meters of at least one active gadget.

Name: Saboteur_basic_gadget_mid_007
Description: Your gadgets cannot be destroyed. Instead, when they would be destroyed they are reduced to 1 HP and gain +100% damage and +100% attack speed until repaired to full HP. Can only trigger once per gadget per deployment.

Name: Masochist_basic_spine_000
Description: Unlocks the Anguish resource. Anguish is generated by health you lose: 1 Anguish per 1% of maximum health lost to damage, and 1 Anguish per 1% of maximum health spent as an ability cost. Healing removes it at the same rate, 1 Anguish per 1% of maximum health restored, so health regeneration is what decays it rather than a timer. Base maximum Anguish is 100.

Name: Masochist_basic_spine_001
Description: +1% increased Maximum Health and +0.5% increased Armor per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_spine_002
Description: +2% increased Health Regeneration per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_spine_003
Description: +1% increased damage per point for 5 seconds after you take damage of a Cataclysm type other than Demonic.

Name: Masochist_basic_spine_004
Description: +2% increased Life Leech per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_spine_005
Description: Damage taken from damage over time effects is reduced by 1% per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_spine_006
Description: +2% increased Anguish gained from health lost to damage per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_spine_007
Description: +2% increased Anguish gained from health spent as an ability cost per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_spine_008
Description: +2% increased maximum Anguish per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_spine_009
Description: +2% increased Crowd Control Resistance per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_spine_010
Description: +3% increased Retaliation per point.

Name: Masochist_keystone_spine_001
Description: While your Anguish is at maximum you deal 20% more damage and take 20% more damage.

Name: Masochist_keystone_spine_002
Description: Health regeneration no longer removes Anguish, but your Health Regeneration is halved.

Name: Masochist_keystone_spine_003
Description: Your Retaliation damage is increased by 1% for each point of Anguish you currently hold.

Name: Masochist_basic_fc_stem0
Description: +3% increased Armor per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_fc_stem1
Description: +1% increased Maximum Health per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_fc_stem2
Description: +3% increased Retaliation per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_fc_a0
Description: +1% increased Attack Damage per point for every 5% of your maximum health that is missing.

Name: Masochist_basic_fc_a1
Description: Taking physical damage grants a stack of Bloodlust for 5 seconds, up to 5 stacks. Each stack gives +1% increased melee physical damage per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_fc_a2
Description: While you are Bleeding, +2% increased Attack Speed per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_fc_b0
Description: +2% increased Armor per point for each unique debuff on you.

Name: Masochist_basic_fc_b1
Description: +3% increased Life Leech per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_fc_b2
Description: Your melee critical strikes have a 5% chance per point to apply Bleeding.

Name: Masochist_basic_fc_c0
Description: +2% increased Anguish gained from health lost to damage per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_fc_c1
Description: +2% increased Crowd Control Resistance per point.

Name: Masochist_keystone_fc_kA
Description: Killing an enemy while above 75 Anguish grants a stack of Carnage for 8 seconds, up to 10 stacks. Each stack gives 3% more melee damage.

Name: Masochist_keystone_fc_kB
Description: Healing from Life Leech does not remove Anguish.

Name: Masochist_keystone_fc_kC
Description: You gain 30% more Anguish from health lost to damage, and 50% less Anguish from health spent as an ability cost.

Name: Masochist_basic_ss_stem0
Description: +1% increased Chaos damage per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ss_stem1
Description: +2% increased Maximum Mana per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ss_stem2
Description: +2% increased Mana Regeneration per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ss_a0
Description: +1% increased Spell Damage per point for every 5% of your maximum mana that is missing.

Name: Masochist_basic_ss_a1
Description: Your spells have a 3% chance per point to cast a second time. The second cast costs 1% of your current health per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ss_a2
Description: Casting a spell grants a stack of Unstable for 5 seconds, up to 5 stacks. Each stack gives +1% increased Spell Damage and +1% increased mana cost per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ss_b0
Description: Using a skill with a mana cost also costs 0.5% of your current health per point. This cannot kill you.

Name: Masochist_basic_ss_b1
Description: +2% increased Anguish gained from health spent as an ability cost per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ss_b2
Description: When your Energy Shield breaks, enemies within 6 metres are stunned for 0.1 seconds per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ss_c0
Description: +2% increased Area of Effect per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ss_c1
Description: +2% increased maximum Anguish per point.

Name: Masochist_keystone_ss_kA
Description: Your spells deal 1% more damage for every 2 points of Anguish you currently hold, but your mana does not regenerate.

Name: Masochist_keystone_ss_kB
Description: Health spent as an ability cost is not taken immediately. It becomes a debuff on you that deals the same total damage over 4 seconds.

Name: Masochist_keystone_ss_kC
Description: You gain 30% more Anguish from health spent as an ability cost, and 50% less Anguish from health lost to damage.

Name: Masochist_basic_fl_stem0
Description: +2% increased damage over time damage per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_fl_stem1
Description: +2% increased damage over time duration per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_fl_stem2
Description: +1% increased Maximum Health per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_fl_a0
Description: For each unique debuff on you, +1% increased damage and +0.5% increased Damage Reduction per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_fl_a1
Description: Damage from debuffs on you is increased by 1% per point, and you deal 1% increased damage per point to enemies carrying a debuff you also carry.

Name: Masochist_basic_fl_a2
Description: Debuffs on you last 2% longer per point, and their effect on you is reduced by 1% per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_fl_b0
Description: When a debuff on you deals damage, enemies within 6 metres have a 1% chance per point to receive a random debuff you carry.

Name: Masochist_basic_fl_b1
Description: When an enemy dies, its debuffs have a 2% chance per point to pass to a random enemy within 6 metres.

Name: Masochist_basic_fl_b2
Description: You radiate an aura that applies a random debuff to enemies within 6 metres every 3 seconds. The duration of those debuffs is increased by 4% per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_fl_c0
Description: +2% increased Anguish gained from health lost to damage over time per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_fl_c1
Description: +2% increased maximum Anguish per point.

Name: Masochist_keystone_fl_kA
Description: You can carry twice as many unique debuffs, and debuffs on you deal 50% more damage to you.

Name: Masochist_keystone_fl_kB
Description: You deal 4% more damage for each unique debuff on you.

Name: Masochist_keystone_fl_kC
Description: Every debuff on you grants 5 Anguish per second for as long as it lasts.

Name: Masochist_basic_ll_stem0
Description: +1% increased Movement Speed per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ll_stem1
Description: +3% increased Critical Strike Multiplier per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ll_stem2
Description: +2% increased Retaliation per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ll_a0
Description: While at or below 35% health, +2% increased damage per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ll_a1
Description: While at or below 20% health, +3% increased Critical Strike Chance per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ll_a2
Description: While at or below 5% health, your skills have a 5% chance per point not to go on cooldown.

Name: Masochist_basic_ll_b0
Description: While at or below 50% health, +1% increased Movement Speed per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ll_b1
Description: Dropping below 50% health converts all damage you take into Bleeding over 5 seconds. The conversion lasts 3 seconds, increased by 5% per point, and cannot happen more than once every 10 seconds.

Name: Masochist_basic_ll_b2
Description: While at or below 10% health, you release a nova every 5 seconds dealing damage equal to 1% of your missing health per point to enemies within 6 metres.

Name: Masochist_basic_ll_c0
Description: +2% increased Anguish gained from health spent as an ability cost per point.

Name: Masochist_basic_ll_c1
Description: +2% increased maximum Anguish per point.

Name: Masochist_keystone_ll_kA
Description: While at or below 20% health you take 25% less damage and your Anguish does not decrease.

Name: Masochist_keystone_ll_kB
Description: You cannot be healed above 50% of your maximum health, but you deal 25% more damage.

Name: Masochist_keystone_ll_kC
Description: While at or below 35% health you gain 10 Anguish per second.

Name: Masochist_capstone_25
Description: Unlocks at 25 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.
Option1Name: Iron Will, but For the Soul
Option1Description: You can no longer be killed by physical damage, but 50% of all physical damage you take is converted to chaos damage.
Option2Name: The Unbreakable, but For the Mind
Option2Description: You can no longer be stunned or frozen, but your Mana and Energy Shield no longer regenerate naturally.
Option3Description: You no longer have a mana pool. All maximum mana is converted into added maximum health, and every ability costs health instead of mana.

Name: Masochist_capstone_50
Description: Unlocks at 50 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.
Option1Name: The Scourge of Flesh, but For the Self
Option1Description: Your attacks and spells have a 10% chance to inflict a stack of Withered on enemies, but every third skill you cast inflicts a stack of Withered on you.
Option2Name: The Immortal Champion, but For the Weak
Option2Description: Dropping below 50% health grants immunity to all damage for 5 seconds, but you deal 50% less damage while it lasts. This cannot happen more than once every 60 seconds.
Option3Name: The Void Embrace, but For the Sanity
Option3Description: For each Void item you have equipped you gain 50% increased chaos damage and lose 10% of your maximum health.

Name: Masochist_capstone_100
Description: Unlocks at 100 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.
Option1Name: Reaper's Gambit, but For the End
Option1Description: When you would drop to 0 health you are restored to full health instead, but you die if you take any damage in the next 10 seconds. This cannot happen more than once every 180 seconds.
Option2Name: The Unyielding, but For the World
Option2Description: You are immune to all debuffs and crowd control, but you cannot receive buffs from other players or from city upgrades.
Option3Name: The Cataclysmic Echo, but For the Soul
Option3Description: Each dungeon modifier in the dungeon you are in has a 10% chance to apply to you as a buff and a 25% chance to apply to you as a curse for the rest of that run.

Name: Masochist_capstone_200
Description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.
Option1Name: The Martyr, but For the Flesh
Option1Description: All damage you take is also dealt to every enemy within 12 metres, but your Health Regeneration is set to zero.
Option2Description: Your Anguish has no maximum, but you take 1% more damage for every 100 Anguish you hold.
Option3Name: The Undying, but For the End
Option3Description: You cannot die while you hold Anguish. Lethal damage instead consumes all of it and leaves you at 1 health. You cannot gain Anguish for 20 seconds afterwards.
